subject: Road to acceptance: proposed schedule & MAP template
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan@oxfordhealth.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Road to acceptance: schedule and MAP template

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the latency numbers looked promising and the team is excited. Legal and Procurement asked us to produce a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out milestones and acceptance criteria so they can map approvals to our quarter close. Can you share a simple MAP template and a proposed 30-60 day schedule we could use?

Key constraints from our side:
- Security review needs a SOC2 evidence package by week 2
- Integration will be a small PoC hitting our dev API (data-scope: pseudonymized)
- Stakeholders: myself (AI product), Laila Ahmed (Security), and Samir Patel (Procurement)

Would appreciate a one-page template + a suggested cadence for checkpoints and a week-by-week critical path. Also attaching the vendor questionnaire we received (see attachment stub).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of AI Product, Oxford Health AI
jordan@oxfordhealth.ai

Attachment: Oxford-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@oxfordhealth.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Road to acceptance: schedule and MAP template

Hi Jordan — great to meet you on the demo call.

I've put together a lightweight MAP template and a proposed week-by-week schedule that maps to the items you called out. Highlights:
- Week 0: kickoff + environment access and stakeholder RACI
- Week 1: SOC2 evidence handoff + smoke test on dev API
- Week 2–3: focused PoC (sample traffic + latency targets) + quality checklists
- Week 4: acceptance run + export of logs/audit samples for your Security team
- Week 5–6: remediation window and final sign-off

I've shared two files: Road-to-Acceptance-MAP-Template.gdoc (editable Google Doc) and 30-60-90-acceptance-slides.pptx (slide deck with milestone dates). Google Doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB2cRoadToAcceptanceTemplate

Quick asks from our side to speed review:
- Can you confirm the primary point of contact for security evidence (Laila or someone else)?
- Which environment do you prefer for the PoC (dev vs sandbox)?
- Do you have a target sign-off window we should aim at (EOM/ quarter-end)?

If helpful we can do a 30-min alignment call tomorrow to walk through the template and adapt the acceptance criteria to your QA checklist.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Road-to-Acceptance-MAP-Template.gdoc (Google Doc link), 30-60-90-acceptance-slides.pptx (pptx)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@oxfordhealth.ai>, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Road to acceptance: schedule and MAP template

Thanks Priyom — doc looks good at a glance. Adding a few technical acceptance bullets so Oxford's Security and SRE teams know what to expect:

Acceptance checklist (technical):
- End-to-end latency: 95th percentile under 250ms for canonical prompt set (we'll share the prompt bundle)
- Throughput: baseline of 50 concurrent requests with steady-state QPS target of 20
- Data handling: confirm pseudonymization pipeline + contractual data scope
- Logging: sample audit logs (redacted) and trace of a test session exported week 4
- Rollback plan: documented fallback model variant + MB rollback trigger

Owners:
- Marissa Cole (R&D) — test plan and trace export
- Ben Carter (Solutions) — PoC integration and dev environment support
- Priyom Das (AE) — stakeholder cadence and SLAs

Jordan — if you can confirm Laila as the security POC and a preferred PoC environment (dev vs sandbox) we'll lock these into the MAP and propose specific dates. I also dropped recommended acceptance thresholds in the doc.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Priyom / Marissa — this is great, thank you. Quick answers:
- Laila Ahmed will be the security POC (laila.ahmed@oxfordhealth.ai)
- We prefer the sandbox environment for the PoC (closer to infra parity)
- Target sign-off: aiming for Friday Jan 29 (end of next month) to align with our procurement window

We can do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 11am PT to walk the MAP and lock dates. I'll invite Laila and Samir. After that please update the gdoc with the dates and owners and we'll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Jordan
